author: OhLookItsDaOne
description:
Configures channels where only images are allowed. Each image message creates a thread for comments and further images. Plain text messages are deleted with a temporary warning.

This cog is based on the original bot code and idea provided by Kat and Vee, who granted permission to modify and reuse it.
install_msg: Cog installed. Use `[p]setgallery <#channel>` to configure a gallery channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only guild configuration (gallery channel IDs, thread name template, hint duration). No end user data is stored.
